prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A stark, minimalist interior scene rendered in high-contrast black and white, evoking the style of early 20th-century German Expressionist cinema. The composition is dominated by a large, sparsely furnished room with tall ceilings and bare walls, creating a sense of emptiness and psychological tension. Two men are present: one stands in the foreground, slightly off-center, wearing a loose-fitting suit with a disheveled appearance, his expression tense and anxious, hands held awkwardly at his sides. The other man sits behind a heavy, dark wooden desk to the right, his posture rigid and authoritative, gazing intently at the standing figure. The furniture—two ornate chairs and the desk—appears oversized, emphasizing the smallness and vulnerability of the standing man. A large window on the right floods the room with harsh, directional light, casting deep shadows and accentuating the angular geometry of the space. The overall mood is somber and oppressive, with a sense of psychological unease heightened by the stark lighting, empty space, and dramatic use of perspective. The camera is positioned at a low, wide angle, capturing the full depth of the room and the isolation of the characters within it.
